what_they_did: Desset and colleagues proposed a phonetic reading of Linear Elamite, anchored on proper names shared with cuneiform Elamite texts (from the item summary; the paper itself was not read).
The Hatamti database publishes each Linear Elamite document with a sign-by-sign transliteration and translation, citing the 2026 edition volume by Desset, Tabibzadeh, Basello and Marchesi.
That volume, 'Linear Elamite Inscriptions and Related Cuneiform Texts, Vol. 1: Linear Elamite Texts from Susa', gives full editions of the Susa texts (Hatamti citation).
what_they_found: Hatamti document 6 (Sb 155) has 50 signs and is read as naming Puzur-Sušinak, king of Awan, with the phrase 'Insušinak loves him'; its edition is in section 3.4.1, pp. 85-91 of the 2026 volume (Hatamti doc 6).
Hatamti document 2 (Sb 6) has 33 signs and runs left to right; its edition is in section 3.3.1, pp. 71-79 (Hatamti doc 2).
No figures from the ZA paper are reported here because it was not read.
strength_and_limits: Linear Elamite now has a public sign-by-sign corpus with readings, which makes it a rare known-answer test for statistical methods.
The reading rests on a small corpus of a few dozen texts and on name anchors, and is not accepted by all specialists; this record cannot weigh that because the paper was not read.
Our own crib test with Linear Elamite as a known answer was negative (experiments/crib_le_known_answer).

authors_next.idea: Further volumes of the Linear Elamite edition series are implied by the 'Vol. 1' title.
authors_next.where: not stated (inferred from the Hatamti citation only)

ideas_for_us.idea: Use the Hatamti Linear Elamite transliterations as a known-answer bench: run each of our structural methods (positional classes, sign clustering, restoration) blind on the Linear Elamite sign strings and score them against the published readings.
ideas_for_us.why: A method that cannot recover known syllable classes or word breaks in a small, deciphered corpus should not be trusted on Indus.
ideas_for_us.data_needed: Sign sequences and readings from the Hatamti database pages, collected with polite rate limits.

ideas_for_us.idea: Measure how short Linear Elamite texts must be cut before the methods fail, by truncating texts to Indus lengths.
ideas_for_us.why: It gives a power curve for methods on texts of four to five signs.
